description: This file contains tests for the functions 'encodeSlackModalPrivateMetadata' and 'parseSlackModalPrivateMetadata', verifying their behavior in parsing and encoding Slack modal private metadata.

methods.name: parseSlackModalPrivateMetadata
methods.description: Parses JSON string input to extract specific Slack modal metadata fields, returning an object with those fields or an empty object for invalid input.

methods.name: encodeSlackModalPrivateMetadata
methods.description: Encodes a metadata object into a JSON string, including only non-empty known fields, and throws an error if the resulting string exceeds Slack's metadata size limit.
